references.text: The ambush in 20:29 is the direct cause of the pursuit and defeat in 20:43.
Benjamin's earlier tactic (20:31) is turned against them and leads to their total destruction in 20:43.
20:36 explains the strategy behind the pursuit carried out in 20:43.
Thematic parallel concerning total pursuit and extermination, but with a contrast in who is the object of God's judgment.
